//==
// # SDF modifiers
//
// Parameter records for standard distance-field transformations. Each
// describes how a source SDF is reshaped; the source itself is supplied by
// the evaluation context. The functions that apply them live in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// Rounds sharp edges and corners by subtracting Radius from the distance,
// inflating the shape and smoothing its features.
type SdfRoundingModifier
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Number;
}
